heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: This is a broad classification of the general type of heritage asset and is intended to enable monuments, buildings and landscape areas to be distinguished from artefacts, text documents (printed materials, books, articles, etc), images (photographs, drawings etc), audio recordings, movies reference and 3D models.  A fixed controlled vocabulary is proposed for use in which the term “Monument” includes archaeological monuments, historic buildings, industrial monuments, archaeological landscape areas and shipwrecks.  The proposed vocabulary is as follows:.                   - Monument.                   - Artefact.                   - Text.                   - Image.                   - Sound.                   - Movie.                   - 3D
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: General classification of the heritage asset. Select from 7 predefined CARARE types.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Allgemeine Klassifikation des Kulturguts. Auswahl aus 7 vordefinierten Typen des CARARE-Schemas.
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderDE: z.B. Artefact | Monument | Text | Image | Sound | Movie | 3D
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderEN: e.g. Artefact | Monument | Text | Image | Sound | Movie | 3D

heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Unique identifier of the creator of the heritage asset (e.g. artist, workshop, sculptor) or another involved person/organisation. If the creator is unknown or cannot be identified, this field can be left empty. Recommendation: use an authority file URI, e.g. GND or Wikidata for historical persons. Workshops as a collective or corporate author can also be given.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Eindeutige Kennung des Schöpfers/der Schöpferin des Kulturguts (z.B. Künstler, Werkstatt, Bildhauer) oder einer anderen beteiligten Person/Organisation. Falls der Schöpfer unbekannt oder nicht identifizierbar ist, kann dieses Feld leer bleiben. Empfehlung: Normdaten-URI verwenden, z.B. GND oder Wikidata für historische Personen. Auch Werkstätten als kollektiver bzw. korporativer Urheber können angegeben werden.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: The observed condition (e.g. good, fair, bad, poor, part destroyed, under restoration.)
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: General professional assessment of the condition. This assessment is based on the expertise of the documenting person and is not defined by fixed thresholds.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Allgemeine fachliche Einschätzung des Erhaltungszustands. Diese Bewertung basiert auf der Expertise der dokumentierenden Person und ist nicht durch feste Schwellenwerte definiert.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: A detailed assessment of the condition of a Heritage Asset, of any treatment required and an estimation of the percentage of the monument affected.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: A detailed assessment of the condition of a heritage asset and any treatment required, including an estimation of the percentage affected.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Detaillierte fachliche Einschätzung des Zustands des Kulturguts, einschließlich erforderlicher Maßnahmen und einer Schätzung des betroffenen Flächenanteils.
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderDE: z.B. Oberflächenverwitterung an der Vorderseite, ca. 15% der Reliefoberfläche betroffen. Konservierungsmaßnahme empfohlen.
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderEN: e.g. Surface weathering on the front, approx. 15% of the relief surface affected. Conservation treatment recommended.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: The date when the assessment of condition was made.. If this is a prehistoric date use the minus (-) sign to denote it.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: The date when the assessment of condition was made. Free text to allow for a descriptive date, e.g. '1950s'. [NEW – per the CARARE schema (3.3 Conditions), previously undocumented.]
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Datum, an dem die Zustandsbewertung vorgenommen wurde. Freitext, um auch ungenaue Datumsangaben zu ermöglichen (z.B. '1950er Jahre'). [NEU – laut CARARE-Schema (3.3 Conditions), bisher nicht dokumentiert.]

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: This is the relation between a heritage asset and an Activity that it was present at. e.g. a castle was present at a siege, a cross was present at a digitization event. Give the id number of the target record or a URI.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Relation to an associated event/activity at which the condition assessment was made. Give the ID number of the target record or a URI.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Verweist auf die Aktivität, bei der diese Zustandsbewertung vorgenommen wurde. ID-Nummer des Zieldatensatzes oder URI angeben.
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderDE: z.B. Restaurierungsmaßnahmen 2010, durchgeführt von einer Diplom-Restauratorin/einem Diplom-Restaurator
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderEN: e.g. conservation measures 2010, carried out by a qualified conservator

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: A free-text statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation. Includes the motivation of the event in which the digital object (2D, 3D, text, movies, images, etc.) was created, the design of hte digitisation process and any factors significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Free text describing the ownership and custody history of the heritage asset since its creation – relevant to its authenticity, integrity and interpretation. Instead of free text, a link to detailed documentation can also be provided.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Freitext zur Eigentums- und Verwahrungsgeschichte des Kulturguts seit seiner Entstehung – relevant für Authentizität, Integrität und Interpretation. Statt Freitext kann auch ein Link zu einer ausführlichen Dokumentation angegeben werden.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: This is a set of index information to describe the character of the monument. Content providers are strongly recommended to complete this element.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: This is a set of index information to describe the character of the monument. Content providers are strongly recommended to complete this element.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Dies ist ein Satz von Indexinformationen zur Beschreibung des Charakters des Denkmals. Datenanbietern wird dringend empfohlen, dieses Element auszufüllen.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: Classification of the monument, building, landscape feature, artefact or ecofact primarily with respect to its function or use, e.g. house. Use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended; the vocabulary used should be indicated using an attribute. No particular common vocabulary is recommended for use.. Content providers are strongly recommended to complete this element.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Typological classification as a monument – e.g. tombstone, dwelling, fortification.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Typologische Einordnung als Denkmal – z.B. Grabstein, Wohnhaus, Befestigung.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: Information about the date and/or period of an entity.. Content providers are strongly recommended to complete this element.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Information about the date and/or period of an entity.. Content providers are strongly recommended to complete this element.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Informationen über das Datum und/oder die Epoche einer Entität.. Datenanbietern wird dringend empfohlen, dieses Element auszufüllen.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: the earliest date in the range (literal)
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Earliest date of the temporal classification of the heritage asset (not of the digitisation). Machine-readable date; negative values denote years BCE.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Frühestes Datum der zeitlichen Einordnung des Kulturguts (nicht der Digitalisierung). Maschinenlesbares Datum; negative Werte bezeichnen Jahre v. Chr. (TODO: Darstellung von Roh- vs. Anzeigewert noch nicht final entschieden, siehe Protokoll.)

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: the latest date in the range (literal)

heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Spätestes Datum der zeitlichen Einordnung des Kulturguts (nicht der Digitalisierung). Maschinenlesbares Datum; negative Werte bezeichnen Jahre v. Chr.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: the nature of the time span given (e.g. throughout, at some time during, etc.) Use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: the nature of the time span given (e.g. throughout, at some time during, etc.) Use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: die Art der angegebenen Zeitspanne (z.B. durchgehend, zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt während usw.). Die Verwendung eines kontrollierten Vokabulars wird empfohlen.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: the name given to the period in history when something occurred. heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: The name given to the historical period in which the object was created. Can be provided in multiple languages, with a preferred value indicated.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Name der historischen Epoche oder Periode, in der das Objekt entstand. Kann mehrsprachig angegeben werden, bevorzugter Wert markierbar.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: a free text field used to display the date or period for users (e.g. early 19th century, 1950s). The element may be repeated using the XML:lang attribute if the element value is available in alternate languages. A preferred/alternate attribute may be used to indicate which value is preferred.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Human-readable date for display purposes in the UI. Can be provided in multiple languages, with a preferred value indicated.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Menschenlesbare Zeitangabe für die Anzeige im UI. Kann mehrsprachig angegeben werden, bevorzugter Wert markierbar.
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderEN: e.g. 3rd third of the 4th century BCE

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: date according to scientific dating methods, e.g. ‘1250 bp +/-30 PBN-1675’, recorded precisely as received from the specialist.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Date according to scientific dating methods (e.g. radiocarbon). Recorded precisely as received from the specialist laboratory, including error margin and lab code.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: e.g. ‘radiocarbon dating’. Use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended; the vocabulary used should be indicated using an attribute. No particular common vocabulary is recommended for use.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Methode der wissenschaftlichen Datierung, die für das wissenschaftliche Datum verwendet wurde. (TODO: Prüfen, ob Feld wiederholbar sein muss, siehe Protokoll.)

heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: The basic materials of which the heritage asset is composed. Multiple entries possible.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Grundmaterial(ien), aus denen das Kulturgut besteht. Mehrere Einträge möglich.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: Text inscribed on a monument or building, if any. The element may be repeated using the XML:lang attribute if the element value is available in alternate languages. A preferred/alternate attribute may be used to indicate which value is preferred. The type of inscription may be indicated using an attribute. Use of a controlled vocabulary to indicate the type of inscription is recommended, and the vocabulary used may be indicated using an attribute. No particular common vocabulary is recommended for use.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Full inscription text, in the original script where applicable. Can be provided in multiple languages.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Vollständiger Inschriftstext, ggf. im Original-Schriftsystem. Kann mehrsprachig angegeben werden.
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderDE: z.B. 1-zeilige Inschrift auf der Giebelleiste: Νικαρέτη Κτησιφῶντος ...
heritageAssetIdentification.placeholderEN: e.g. 1-line inscription on the cornice: Νικαρέτη Κτησιφῶντος ...

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: This element allows the part of the heritage asset being measured to be indicated, for example 'base' (meaning the base or bottom of the monument, building or object.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Notes the part of the heritage asset being measured.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Gibt an, welcher Teil des Kulturguts vermessen wird.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: e.g. height, length, width, depth, shape (e.g. oval)
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Indicates the type of measurement.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Bezeichnet die Art der Messung.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentation: e.g. metres, centimetres
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Gives the unit of measurement.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Gibt die verwendete Maßeinheit an.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Scale information, if relevant – e.g. for models, replicas or scaled representations. For original objects at original size, this field can be left empty.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Maßstabsangabe, falls relevant – z.B. bei Modellen, Repliken oder maßstäblichen Darstellungen. Bei Originalobjekten in Originalgröße kann dieses Feld leer bleiben.

heritageAssetIdentification.documentationEN: Numerical measurement value in the specified unit.
heritageAssetIdentification.documentationDE: Numerischer Messwert in der angegebenen Einheit.

digitalResource.documentation: this is the relation between a digital resource and the heritage asset  that it represents, e.g. a digital image is a representation of a monument.  Give the id number of the target record or a URI

digitalResource.documentationDE: Beziehung zwischen dieser digitalen Ressource und anderen digitalen Ressourcen, die sie enthält.
